scope: SYS12 ArtifactCache assignment-prefetch persistence slice only

phases.purpose: guard image/root/network; write owned private config/data; start A; fresh Node HELLO
one exact 32-byte Artifact, capture only id/size/sha; verify GET metadata
one unique un-deployed Application; assignment drives DesiredState Sync and Agent prefetch
query-only DB row + physical cache bytes/SHA/UID/inode, exact Agent PID/exe/cgroup/open DB FD, no unit file
stop/remove exact A; pre-B persisted DB/cache snapshot; start B on same owned bridge/DataDir
B sync/open-FD proof; same Node/Agent/DB/cache/App assignment; revision non-regression; zero App executions/unit
unassign; exact DELETE App/Artifact/Node and GET 404
remove exact stopped A/B ids and exact owner bridge
after API 404 + runtime removal only: remove exact config/data and approved 32-byte cache SHA file; unknown path/symlink blocks

primary_oracles: Assigned un-deployed App appears in local SQLite applications table with exact artifact id and revision.
SQLite artifacts row path is /var/lib/nodesteer/artifacts/<sha256>; target is regular non-symlink owned UID/GID 65534, exactly 32 bytes and SHA-valid.
File SHA/size/dev/inode, DB dev/inode, node_id/agent_id and App record match across A, A-stop/pre-B, and B.
Exact Agent PID is non-zombie UID 65534, cgroup matches container id, /proc/<pid>/exe SHA matches pinned Agent, and an open FD references the same state.db dev/inode.
B local global revision is >= pre-B and current synced Hub revision; no requirement that global revision remain unchanged.
Application executions endpoint is empty; local execution count for App is zero; exact container's systemd unit file is absent. No Deploy request is issued.

runtime_order: stop/remove exact owned container IDs only
remove exact owned bridge ID and prove absent
cleanup.root_rule: Only approved cache artifact SHA file plus exact expected config/state.db/WAL/SHM may be removed. Any unknown entry, symlink, identity mismatch or active helper stops cleanup.
cleanup.execution_audit: Preserve helper Execution/Audit history; exact helper Task must be terminal before DELETE and GET 404.
